title: Nozzle depositing a yellow-brown material onto a print bed
visual_facts: A large gray cylindrical nozzle assembly hangs over a flat dark work surface.
The nozzle is positioned over a short ridged column made of yellow-brown material.
Two similar ridged material forms of different heights sit to the left on the same surface.
spatial_relations: The nozzle is directly above the tallest form, which is at the right.
The smaller forms are arranged progressively to the left of the nozzle.
uncertainties: The material and exact type of printer are not identifiable from the image alone.
